data.name: Mayuresh Behere
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Mayuresh Behere has made a big mark in cricket. With 40 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 74*, with an average of 16.88 and a quick strike rate of 149.17. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 40 sixes and 37 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 21.4 overs, taking 11 wickets at an economy rate of 11.68. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
